draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.55, the 250th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 19th of 19 at DT. He went 156th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (250th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: bench press (11th percentile). College production: 2 sacks in 2020, 10th of 19 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets (practice squad). 60 career games and 7 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (12th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 interior lineman who played: 0 pressures against a median of 6, below the norm.
